components.name: component/top_bar_gallery

components.rules: 相册类帧顶栏一律用实例; gallery/empty 父帧绝对定位需覆写 layoutPositioning:ABSOLUTE+x:0+y:0+width:393; 根透明底, 双模判定走语义判据(不透明像素 dark≈239→light≈50); 变体候选未收: scanning(ic/pause 换 ic/scan)、search 4-node 组(back+search_field+result_count, 宜独立组件)、People detail(btn_back+title+btn_save)

components.rules: Chat 媒体结果卡一律用实例; 照片覆写 U(inst,{fills:[IMAGE]}), 日期覆写 U(inst+"387:136",{characters}); 子树颜色 token(color/white、canvasPureBlack、chatCarousel/feedbackBgColor)双模同值, 双模 PNG 一致属预期; 变体未收: chat/conversation Carousel 首卡(15-node, thumb_up 叠 3 重复 Vector, 渲染等价, 待清理)

components.name: component/person_card
components.purpose: People 人物网格卡(174宽竖卡, cover 174x174 IMAGE + count_badge 照片数角标 + info 区 person_name + relation_chip + btn_more)
components.rules: People grid 人物卡一律用实例; 覆写路径(主组件子id): cover 图 U(inst+"387:147",{fills:[IMAGE]}), 角标 U(inst+"387:152",{characters:"$184:xx"}), 人名 U(inst+"387:157",{characters:"$184:xx"}[,fontSize]), chip 底/文 U(inst+"387:154"/inst+"387:158",{fills:["$2:xx"]})+chip 文案 U(inst+"387:158",{characters:"$184:x"}); 文本全绑字符串变量(people.grid.count.*/people.grid.name.*/person.relation.*), 实例按卡重绑变量, 勿写文本字面量; 已收 5 实例 card_mom/dad/alex/lin/chris(387:161-165), 仅数据级差异(图/文案/chip 色对/chris 人名 fontSize=13); 根 DROP_SHADOW 色为效果字面量(检测器豁免, 现状沿用); 变体未收: card_unnamed(171:75, cover 无照片+ic/face_placeholder 占位+chip 描边样式, 结构不同构)

components.name: component/category_card
components.purpose: Organize hub 六分类卡(横条 64 高, icon_block 28x28 圆角图标底 + title_col(title 13pt/meta 11pt) + thumbs 四连缩略图 + chevron ›)
components.rules: Organize hub 分类卡一律用实例; 覆写路径(主组件子id): 图标换主组件 U(inst+"387:174",{ref:"132:xx"})(实例 swap 通路, 4c-5 实证 U 可改 ref, 官方文档误称不可), 标题 U(inst+"387:175",{characters:"$343:xx"}), 副标题 U(inst+"387:176",{characters:"$343:xx"}), 缩略图 U(inst+"387:177".."387:180",{fills:[IMAGE]}); 文本全绑字符串变量(org.cat.*/org.meta.*), 实例按卡重绑变量, 勿写文本字面量; 已收 6 实例 cat_duplicates/screenshots/blurry/eyesclosed/videos/documents(387:182-187), 仅数据级差异(图标/文案/缩略图); 图标主组件映射: duplicates=ic/grid(132:137) screenshots=ic/crop(132:89) blurry=ic/erase(132:109) eyesclosed=ic/face(132:97) videos=ic/camera(132:73) documents=ic/sort(132:49)
